title: P3 tools/call: response
description: Outcome of a call by the MCP profile: the tool output as a separate content block with the untrusted mark (INJ-4); on denial isError: true, the model gets only a short "no permission", the full reason is in the audit (PRM-8). Outcomes of built-in tools go as closed fields in structuredContent by the tool schema (for example request-action-result, service-control-result).
